title: Recent developments in the organocatalytic asymmetric cycloaddition/annulation reactions involving indolylmethanols
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,11478-11495
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA10041K, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Arun Patel, Harshit, Eldhose Iype, Indresh Kumar
This review highlights recent advances in catalytic asymmetric reactions using indolylmethanols—particularly in chiral phosphoric acid-mediated cycloaddition and annulation processes, with a focus on organocatalytic approaches.
